data.body: [P2] Establish a regression test for the dependency fix. CONTRIBUTING rule 5 requires a test reproducing the original bug, but no added test checks resolution of `aws-lambda` from the published package's dependencies. The OTel fixture unconditionally links the workspace's entire `node_modules/@types` directory, so its consumer typecheck still passes if this dependency moves back to `devDependencies`. Under rule 9, return to the design/validation phase with a consumer test isolated from workspace devDependencies and record failing-before/passing-after evidence.
